about: Corrections to the input display read from the video (data/full/bits.npy, inputs.py), applied by beam.Beam when it loads the bits: each entry ORs `set` into (and clears `clear` from) the bits of video frames v0..v1, with the evidence that the game saw other keys than the display shows. Bits as in bits.npy (1 = held; A 0x1, B 0x2, Select 0x4, Start 0x8, Right 0x10, Left 0x20, Up 0x40, Down 0x80, R 0x100, L 0x200).

fixes.why: Mr. Weather comp 2 (map 0x83:0x01), game ~435843: the display drops A for a frame while MegaMan lays the rainbow-orb trail; a release resets the trail (sub_809005C tests Joypad held & A every frame), but the video's trail keeps every orb coloured and closes into the ring that captures the tornado at ~435930 (probes/tornfit.py pictures). With the drop our trail resets and the capture never happens.

Underground 2 soul-weapon flames, game ~530715: the display shows Up for one frame (540384) while B is held; the game needs it for two to move the target (a one-frame tap makes MegaMan walk); with Up through 540385 our game opens 'Attack with the SoulAx, drip?' as the video does (probe tapfix.py, 2026-10-16)
